items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I watch Lawrence Welk, Lawrence's show, every week... She just adored him, just absolutely adored him.

ctx.x: And Marshall has said that Lawrence wants him to come back and do another one.

Well, honestly, it was so fantastic, I'm so glad you mentioned that, Pat, because the night he was -- I didn't know he was going to be on. I watch Lawrence Welk, Lawrence's show, every week, and my mother, incidentally -- I don't think I mentioned too much about my mother, who lived with me. Did I mention this earlier?
